summary: Staff SDET with 9.3 years of experience driving quality transformation and continuous testing for enterprise, cloud-native SaaS products across multi-region deployments (US, UK). Proven in scaling quality practices to support rapid product growth while minimizing test effort and operational cost through AI-driven test automation and intelligent quality workflows.

Specialized in building org-wide QA platforms and shift-left strategies, with deep understanding of application behavior, microservices architecture, and service-level debugging. Leveraging AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to accelerate test development, code review, and debugging processes, significantly improving team velocity and code quality. Recognized for embedding quality engineering and test-driven development practices into engineering culture by combining automation, AI-assisted development, system design, and strong collaboration with backend and platform teams.
